title: pm-dispatch: a held Tier H ACCEPT left four PRs without pm:awaiting-merge or a review request for hours — make the seat patrol check its own held PRs for the four-piece terminal
body:
domain:devx#3 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5njkh3xbcDN6EtSfw7

Filing gate: maintainer-directed. The maintainer asked 「如何避免类似的问题」, then said 「开 skills卡」 (project thread, 2026-11-08T16:00Z).

## What happened

`domain:devx#3` held four Tier H PRs for the maintainer's merge: #31282, #31329, #31429 and #31468. Each one got a seat ACCEPT, plus a CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER PASS where one was owed. None got the `pm:awaiting-merge` label, and none had review requested from `GOVERNED_APPROVERS`. #31429 and #31468 sat that way for about six hours. The maintainer noticed them missing from his inbox (2026-11-08T15:48Z), and the seat fixed both at 15:50Z.

The rule was not missing. Each of these already states it:

- `SKILL.md` L183–196: the four-piece terminal for a Tier H path. ② is "PR 悬着等人批,同笔挂 `pm:awaiting-merge`".
- The `check-governed-merges.mjs` verdict ends with "ACCEPT on the card, `pm:awaiting-merge` on the PR, the final 维护者速读, review requested from GOVERNED_APPROVERS".
- `check-half-states.mjs` has the row (`GOVERNED_PR_AWAITING_MERGE_LABEL`, the "accepted and UNFINDABLE" shape).

## Why the rule did not catch it

1. **The seat read the verdict truncated.** It piped `check-governed-merges` through `tail -3`, which cut off the terminal line. That one is seat discipline.
2. **No patrol step looks for it.**
   - The half-state sweep has been on demand only since ruling #208 on #19491; the last scheduled view on #9857 dates from 2026-09-21.
   - The seat patrol duties (`execution-duties.md`, `seat-lifecycle.md`, `landing-operations.md`) never tell a seat to re-check the PRs it holds for the maintainer.
   - So a missed terminal stays missed until the maintainer notices it himself.

## Ask (skill text only)

1. In the seat's patrol duties, add one line. Each round, for every open PR the seat holds on the Tier H or over-3000-line terminal, confirm all four pieces on the current head:
   - the seat record;
   - `pm:awaiting-merge`;
   - a review request to `GOVERNED_APPROVERS`;
   - the final 维护者速读.

   Complete any missing piece in the same round. A cheap reader is enough, for example `check-half-states.mjs` run locally, or a `gh` read of the seat's own PRs. It must not need the retired scheduled sweep back.
2. In the landing step, one clause: read the `check-governed-merges` verdict whole, never truncated. Its last line is the terminal checklist.

⛔ No new gate, workflow or script. ⛔ Do not reschedule `half-state-patrol.yml`; ruling #208 stands. The skill text is ratcheted (`check-skill-line-ratchet`, #29471), so fit both lines by rewording or replacing existing lines rather than growing the file. `Clause-②: no` · `Metadata-protocol: none`. `.claude/**` is governed Tier S.

Related: #31429, #31468, #31282, #31329, #9857, #19491.
